services.name: Sailing Charter
services.desc: 2-8 Hour Options About Coastal cruising along beautiful Santa Barbara, California. Any food and drink is welcomed, there are no extra fees or corkage fees. We also have bottled water and sodas onboard for refreshments. It’s good to bring a jacket just in case, as it is normally about 10 degrees cooler on the water during warmer months. More Info Come out for a sail along the coast of Santa Barbara in the comfort and safety of Star Jasmine, a 31ʼ sailboat.
